Mid-session the sandbox began terminating Go process execution: `go test` hangs and is SIGTERM'd, and even `go run main.go` on a trivial hello-world program is killed. `go test ./pkg/contracts/...`, which had succeeded in 0.237s earlier in the same session, fails identically, so this is an environment regression and not a property of the change. `go build` and `go test -c` still work because they do not execute the produced binary. CI runs the real `go test` suite.

runtimeGap: None. This change touches test files only: no production source file is modified, so no API route, database row, permission code, menu componentKey or runtime behaviour can change. The frontend spec is executed by the blocking Quality Gates smoke job (quality.yml runs `npm run test:smoke:platform:contracts && npm run test:smoke:system:pages`), and the Go test package is executed by ci.yml.
knownGaps: The five frontend/tests/smoke/platform/system-secondary-route-*.spec.ts and backoffice-ui-visual.spec.ts files share ~280 duplicated lines of identical local harness (artifactDir, ensureArtifactDir, collectRuntimeErrors, expectNoViewportOverflow, fulfillJson, viewportCases) that could be moved into the existing tests/smoke/helpers/ directory. Deliberately NOT done in this change: those specs are only exercised by the report-only daily smoke-full workflow, so the extraction would not be covered by any PR-blocking gate and a regression would only surface after merge.

The remaining Go *_test.go hotspots (permission 124 dl, dept 116 dl, login 105 dl, middleware ~180 dl) are table-driven fixture data. SonarCloud normalises string literals in its Go duplication detection — proven by the fact that blocks with entirely different fixture values are grouped together — so these need structural rewrites (shared seed helpers with per-kind error messages, or merged table-driven tests) rather than simple extraction.

frontend/tests/smoke/system/governance/permission-workbench-remediation.spec.ts (182 dl) and the frontend/src list pages (OperationLogList 152, RoleList 130, LoginLogList 103, PostList 93, DeptList 85) are the next largest clusters but were left untouched: the former needs a behavioural read-through of the workbench assertions, and the latter are production UI where the repo already has a shared component layer and further extraction has a much worse readability trade-off.

SonarCloud's overall duplicated_lines_density is not a quality-gate condition (only new_duplicated_lines_density is, with a 3% threshold). The 3.16% target is therefore a project objective, not a merge blocker, and the authoritative confirmation requires the hosted re-analysis after CI.

go test could not be executed locally (sandbox now kills Go process execution). Compilation of the test package was verified with go test -c, and the transformation was proven line-equivalent, but the suite itself is verified by CI only.

The full root script suite (node --test tests/scripts/*.test.mjs) reports 74 failed / 76 passed on this host, but every failure traces to the sandbox refusing to spawn child processes: the fixtures call execFileSync, which fails with 'spawnSync git EBUSY' / 'spawnSync node EBUSY', and the tests that assert on a child exit code then see status null (e.g. 'null !== 1'). None of the failures is check-duplication.test.mjs, which passes 2/2, and none is caused by the includeRoots change. CI's npm run test:scripts runs the same suite in an environment that can spawn.
